name: VPSUForm – Easy Form Builder – Contact Forms, Conversion Form & More
author: Vikas Ratudi

sections.description:
VPSUForm is your all-in-one WordPress form builder that’s powerful, lightning-fast, and beginner-friendly.

Whether you need a contact form, survey, booking form, feedback form, or custom application form, VPSUForm lets you create it in just a few clicks.

With drag-and-drop simplicity, full mobile responsiveness, and time-saving integrations, VPSUForm makes form creation effortless for bloggers, businesses, and developers alike.

Create your VPSUForm in a minute

📌 All the Fields You’ll Ever Need

  • Basic Fields: Title, Single Line Text, Paragraph Text, Dropdown Field
  • Choice Fields: Multiple Choice (Radio Buttons), Checkboxes, Range Slider, Net Promoter Score, Rating
  • Contact Fields: Name, Email Address, Phone, Phone with Country Code, Website/URL, Address
  • Advanced Fields: Password, Date/Time, Date, Time, Months, Weeks, Color Picker, Hidden Field
  • Media & Extras: File Upload, Image, Link, Terms & Conditions, Page Break, Divider, Button
  • Anti-Spam: reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha

⚡ Powerful Features at Your Fingertips

  • Easy & Fast Drag-and-Drop Builder
  • Active/Inactive Form Status Toggle
  • Easy Edit/Delete
  • Multiple Email Notifications & Templates
  • Custom Confirmation (Message, Show Page, Redirect URL)
  • User Details Display on Page
  • Entries Management: List, Export, and New “Entries Addon” Feature
  • Integrations: Google Sheets, Webhooks, Zapier, SMTP
  • Logic & Automation: Conditional Logic, Elementor & Default WordPress Editor Compatibility
  • Export & Backup: Download entries instantly
  • Security: reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha

🎯 Why Users Love VPSUForm

  • 100% Mobile Responsive — looks great on any device
  • No coding needed — perfect for beginners and pros
  • Seamless integration with your favorite tools
  • Fast, lightweight, and fully optimized for performance

👉 Visit VPSUForm Official Website

sections.faq:
Who should use VPSUForm?

VPSUForm is perfect for business owners, bloggers, designers, developers, photographers — basically anyone who needs a custom WordPress form. If you want to create beautiful, functional forms without hassle, VPSUForm’s drag & drop builder is for you.

Do I need coding skills to use VPSUForm?

Not at all! VPSUForm is 100% beginner-friendly. You can create, customize, and manage forms without writing a single line of code.

What types of forms can I build with VPSUForm?

With VPSUForm’s powerful yet simple builder, you can create:

  • Contact Forms
  • Job Application Forms
  • Feedback or Survey Forms
  • Suggestion Forms
  • Change Request Forms
  • Online Booking Forms
  • Event Registration Forms
  • Maintenance Request Forms
  • Referral Forms
  • Volunteer Registration Forms
    …and many more!

Which form fields does VPSUForm offer?

VPSUForm includes 30+ field types like text, email, phone, dropdowns, radio buttons, checkboxes, date/time pickers, file uploads, rating fields, color pickers, and more.

Does VPSUForm include spam protection?

Yes. VPSUForm supports Google reCAPTCHA and hCaptcha to help block spam and bots.

Can I export form data to CSV?

Yes. You can easily export all form entries to CSV for backups, reports, or integration with other tools.

What if I experience a problem?

You can contact us anytime through our support page. We’re here to help.
